tools.name: list_contacts
tools.title: List Contacts
tools.description: Filter VantoOS hub contacts by contact_type, lead_type, temperature, tag, or free-text search (matches name/email/phone). Returns up to 100 results. Read-only.

search.description: Free-text search across name, email, phone

tools.name: get_contact
tools.title: Get Contact
tools.description: Full detail for one VantoOS hub contact, by id, phone, or email. Read-only.

tools.name: update_contact
tools.title: Update Contact
tools.description: Edit a VantoOS hub contact's name, email, lead_type, temperature, tags, or consent flags. Only the fields you provide are changed — everything else is left untouched.

tools.name: add_contact_note
tools.title: Add Contact Note
tools.description: Append a timestamped note to a VantoOS hub contact. Strictly additive — never overwrites existing notes.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.title: List Projects
tools.description: List your VantoOS projects (pinned first, then most recently updated). Use this to resolve a project name to its id before attaching a task, reminder, meeting, or note to it. Read-only.

tools.name: add_project_note
tools.title: Add Project Note
tools.description: Add a note to a specific project's daily note (get project_id from list_projects first). If a note already exists for that project on that day, this appends to it rather than overwriting. Defaults to today if note_date is omitted.

tools.name: add_diary_entry
tools.title: Add Diary Entry
tools.description: Add an entry to your VantoOS Voice Diary. This is a personal log, distinct from project notes — optionally tag it to one or more projects via linked_project_ids (get ids from list_projects).

linked_project_ids.description: Project ids this entry relates to

tools.name: create_task
tools.title: Create Task
tools.description: Create a new VantoOS task, optionally attached to a project via project_id (get one from list_projects first). Duplicate titles within the same project scope are merged rather than creating a second task.

project_id.description: Attach this task to a project

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.title: List Tasks
tools.description: List your VantoOS tasks — powers 'what's on my plate today' style questions (Dashboard / Plan Hub 'Tasks' tab). Filter by project_id, status, and/or a single calendar day via date (YYYY-MM-DD, matches due_date). Set include_undated to also surface tasks with no due date alongside that day's results. Read-only.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD — filters to tasks due on this day

include_undated.description: Also include tasks with no due_date

tools.name: complete_task
tools.title: Complete Task
tools.description: Mark a VantoOS task as done (sets status to 'done'). Use list_tasks first to find the task id.

tools.name: delete_task
tools.title: Delete Task
tools.description: Delete a VantoOS task. This is a soft delete (the task is hidden from list_tasks and future dedupe checks but not physically removed). Use list_tasks first to find the task id.

tools.name: create_reminder
tools.title: Create Reminder
tools.description: Create a new VantoOS reminder, optionally attached to a project via project_id.

tools.name: list_reminders
tools.title: List Reminders
tools.description: List your VantoOS reminders — powers 'what's on my plate today' style questions (Dashboard / Plan Hub 'Reminders' tab). Filter by project_id, is_done, and/or a single calendar day via date (YYYY-MM-DD, matches reminder_time). Read-only.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD — filters to reminders on this day

tools.name: complete_reminder
tools.title: Complete Reminder
tools.description: Mark a VantoOS reminder as done (sets is_done to true). Use list_reminders first to find the reminder id.

tools.name: delete_reminder
tools.title: Delete Reminder
tools.description: Permanently delete a VantoOS reminder. This is a hard delete — there is no undo. Use list_reminders first to find the reminder id.

tools.name: create_meeting
tools.title: Create Meeting
tools.description: Create a new VantoOS meeting, optionally attached to a project via project_id.

tools.name: list_meetings
tools.title: List Meetings
tools.description: List your VantoOS meetings — powers 'what's on my plate today' style questions (Dashboard / Plan Hub 'Meetings' tab). Filter by project_id, is_done, and/or a single calendar day via date (YYYY-MM-DD, matches start_time). Read-only.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD — filters to meetings on this day

tools.name: complete_meeting
tools.title: Complete Meeting
tools.description: Mark a VantoOS meeting as done (sets is_done to true). Use list_meetings first to find the meeting id.

tools.name: delete_meeting
tools.title: Delete Meeting
tools.description: Permanently delete a VantoOS meeting. This is a hard delete — there is no undo. Use list_meetings first to find the meeting id.

tools.name: get_finance_snapshot
tools.title: Get Finance Snapshot
tools.description: Curated Finance summary: last-30-days income/expense/net, top expense categories, debt summary (count + total outstanding), income streams (target vs actual), and upcoming budget events. The right first call for a budget review. Read-only.

tools.name: list_finance_entries
tools.title: List Finance Entries
tools.description: List Finance ledger entries (income or expense). Filter by type, category, and/or a date range via from/to (YYYY-MM-DD, matches entry_date). Read-only.

tools.name: create_finance_entry
tools.title: Create Finance Entry
tools.description: Log a new Finance ledger entry (income or expense).

tools.name: update_finance_entry
tools.title: Update Finance Entry
tools.description: Edit a Finance ledger entry. Use list_finance_entries first to find the entry id. Only the fields you provide are changed.

tools.name: delete_finance_entry
tools.title: Delete Finance Entry
tools.description: Delete a Finance ledger entry. Soft delete — same as the app's own delete button, fully recoverable in the database if needed. Use list_finance_entries first to find the entry id.

tools.name: list_debts
tools.title: List Debts
tools.description: List debts. Filter by status (e.g. 'active', 'settled'). Read-only.

tools.name: create_debt
tools.title: Create Debt
tools.description: Add a new debt.

tools.name: update_debt
tools.title: Update Debt
tools.description: Edit a debt — balance, rate, repayment, due day, status, or notes. Use list_debts first to find the debt id. Only the fields you provide are changed.

tools.name: delete_debt
tools.title: Delete Debt
tools.description: Delete a debt. Soft delete. Use list_debts first to find the debt id.

tools.name: list_income_streams
tools.title: List Income Streams
tools.description: List income streams with monthly target vs actual. Read-only.

tools.name: create_income_stream
tools.title: Create Income Stream
tools.description: Add a new income stream.

tools.name: update_income_stream
tools.title: Update Income Stream
tools.description: Edit an income stream. Use list_income_streams first to find the id. Only the fields you provide are changed.

tools.name: delete_income_stream
tools.title: Delete Income Stream
tools.description: Delete an income stream. Soft delete. Use list_income_streams first to find the id.

tools.name: list_opportunities
tools.title: List Opportunities
tools.description: List savings/income/funding/compliance opportunities. Filter by status. Read-only.

tools.name: create_opportunity
tools.title: Create Opportunity
tools.description: Add a new opportunity (a savings idea, income idea, funding lead, or compliance item).

tools.name: update_opportunity
tools.title: Update Opportunity
tools.description: Edit an opportunity. Use list_opportunities first to find the id. Only the fields you provide are changed.

tools.name: delete_opportunity
tools.title: Delete Opportunity
tools.description: Delete an opportunity. Soft delete. Use list_opportunities first to find the id.

tools.name: list_budget_items
tools.title: List Budget Items
tools.description: List recurring bills/subscriptions. Filter by status. Read-only.

tools.name: create_budget_item
tools.title: Create Budget Item
tools.description: Add a new recurring bill/subscription.

tools.name: update_budget_item
tools.title: Update Budget Item
tools.description: Edit a recurring bill/subscription. Use list_budget_items first to find the id. Only the fields you provide are changed.

tools.name: delete_budget_item
tools.title: Delete Budget Item
tools.description: Delete a recurring bill/subscription. Soft delete. Use list_budget_items first to find the id.

tools.name: list_upcoming_budget_events
tools.title: List Upcoming Budget Events
tools.description: List individual bill instances (due dates) in a date range. Defaults to today onward if from is omitted. Read-only.

tools.name: mark_budget_event_paid
tools.title: Mark Budget Event Paid
tools.description: Mark a bill instance as paid. Use list_upcoming_budget_events first to find the event id.

tools.name: update_budget_event_status
tools.title: Update Budget Event Status
tools.description: Change a bill instance's status directly (e.g. back to 'upcoming', or to 'skipped'). Use list_upcoming_budget_events first to find the event id.

tools.name: list_shopping_items
tools.title: List Shopping Items
tools.description: List shopping list items. Filter by category, spend_type, and/or done status. Read-only.

tools.name: add_shopping_item
tools.title: Add Shopping Item
tools.description: Add a shopping list item. Capture need_vs_want and a short justification up front — that's the buy-decision framework applied at entry, not left for later.

justification.description: Why it's needed, or how it profits you

tools.name: update_shopping_item
tools.title: Update Shopping Item
tools.description: Edit a shopping list item. Use list_shopping_items first to find the item id. Only the fields you provide are changed.

tools.name: complete_shopping_item
tools.title: Complete Shopping Item
tools.description: Mark a shopping item bought. Pass actual_cost if it differs from the original estimate. Set log_to_finance:true to also create the matching Finance expense (category = the item's category, business/personal split from the item's spend_type) — needs either actual_cost here or an existing unit_cost_estimate on the item to have an amount to log.

tools.name: delete_shopping_item
tools.title: Delete Shopping Item
tools.description: Delete a shopping list item. Soft delete. Use list_shopping_items first to find the item id.

tools.name: list_trips
tools.title: List Trips
tools.description: List trips. Filter by status and/or spend_type. Read-only.

tools.name: create_trip
tools.title: Create Trip
tools.description: Add a trip. Capture need_vs_want and a short justification up front (the buy-decision framework applied at entry) — especially worth using here since trips tend to be bigger, less frequent spends than shopping items.

justification.description: Purpose / expected return on this trip

tools.name: update_trip
tools.title: Update Trip
tools.description: Edit a trip, including its status (upcoming/in-progress/completed/cancelled). Use list_trips first to find the trip id. Only the fields you provide are changed.

tools.name: delete_trip
tools.title: Delete Trip
tools.description: Delete a trip. Soft delete. Use list_trips first to find the trip id.

tools.name: add_trip_expense
tools.title: Add Trip Expense
tools.description: Add an expense to a trip (flights, hotel, fuel...). Always also creates the matching Finance expense (category 'travel', business/personal split from the trip's spend_type) so trip cost never drifts out of sync with Finance. Use list_trips first to get the trip_id.

tools.name: update_trip_expense
tools.title: Update Trip Expense
tools.description: Edit a trip expense. Amount/date/label edits also update the mirrored Finance entry. Use get_trip_budget_status first to find the expense id.

tools.name: delete_trip_expense
tools.title: Delete Trip Expense
tools.description: Delete a trip expense. Soft delete — also soft-deletes the mirrored Finance entry, so the two never drift apart. Use get_trip_budget_status first to find the expense id.

tools.name: get_trip_budget_status
tools.title: Get Trip Budget Status
tools.description: Get one trip plus all its expenses, total spent, and (if budgeted_amount was set) how much budget remains. Read-only.

tools.name: list_trusted_sources
tools.title: List Trusted Sources
tools.description: List trusted vendors/sources (places you trust for good value). Filter by category. Read-only.

tools.name: add_trusted_source
tools.title: Add Trusted Source
tools.description: Add a trusted vendor/source.

category.description: e.g. groceries, electronics, household, business_supplies, travel, general

notes.description: Why it's trusted — price, quality, reliability

tools.name: update_trusted_source
tools.title: Update Trusted Source
tools.description: Edit a trusted vendor/source. Use list_trusted_sources first to find the id. Only the fields you provide are changed.

tools.name: delete_trusted_source
tools.title: Delete Trusted Source
tools.description: Delete a trusted vendor/source. Soft delete. Use list_trusted_sources first to find the id.

tools.name: list_wellness_metrics
tools.title: List Wellness Metrics
tools.description: List Wellness vitals entries (weight, body fat %, waist, blood pressure, resting HR, steps, sleep hours, water intake). Read-only.

tools.name: add_wellness_metric
tools.title: Add Wellness Metric
tools.description: Log a Wellness vitals entry for a given day. Every field is optional except the date (which defaults to today) — log just the ones you have.

tools.name: delete_wellness_metric
tools.title: Delete Wellness Metric
tools.description: Delete a Wellness vitals entry. Soft delete. Use list_wellness_metrics first to find the id.

tools.name: list_wellness_workouts
tools.title: List Wellness Workouts
tools.description: List logged workouts. Filter by category. Read-only.

tools.name: add_wellness_workout
tools.title: Add Wellness Workout
tools.description: Log a workout — a run, a lift, a yoga class, anything.

tools.name: delete_wellness_workout
tools.title: Delete Wellness Workout
tools.description: Delete a logged workout. Soft delete. Use list_wellness_workouts first to find the id.

tools.name: list_wellness_documents
tools.title: List Wellness Documents
tools.description: List doctor's reports (lab results, consultations, imaging, prescriptions). Metadata only — does not include any attached file content. Filter by category. Read-only.

tools.name: add_wellness_document
tools.title: Add Wellness Document
tools.description: Add a doctor's report — metadata only (title, category, doctor, dates, notes). This tool cannot attach a file; use the Wellness page in the app to upload the actual PDF/image.

tools.name: delete_wellness_document
tools.title: Delete Wellness Document
tools.description: Delete a doctor's report. Soft delete. Use list_wellness_documents first to find the id.

tools.name: list_wellness_conditions
tools.title: List Wellness Conditions
tools.description: List Health Profile entries — ongoing conditions, allergies, medications, and immunizations. Filter by item_type. Read-only.

tools.name: add_wellness_condition
tools.title: Add Wellness Condition
tools.description: Add an entry to the Health Profile — a condition, allergy, medication, or immunization.

tools.name: update_wellness_condition_status
tools.title: Update Wellness Condition Status
tools.description: Change a Health Profile entry's status (e.g. mark a condition resolved). Use list_wellness_conditions first to find the id.

tools.name: delete_wellness_condition
tools.title: Delete Wellness Condition
tools.description: Delete a Health Profile entry. Soft delete. Use list_wellness_conditions first to find the id.

tools.name: list_wellness_journal
tools.title: List Wellness Journal
tools.description: List Wellness journal entries. Read-only.

tools.name: add_wellness_journal_entry
tools.title: Add Wellness Journal Entry
tools.description: Add a Wellness journal entry — how you're feeling, energy, sleep, progress toward goals.

tools.name: delete_wellness_journal_entry
tools.title: Delete Wellness Journal Entry
tools.description: Delete a Wellness journal entry. Soft delete. Use list_wellness_journal first to find the id.

tools.name: list_wellness_goals
tools.title: List Wellness Goals
tools.description: List Wellness goals across Body, Mind, and Health domains. Filter by status. Read-only.

tools.name: add_wellness_goal
tools.title: Add Wellness Goal
tools.description: Set a new Wellness goal. If target_metric is 'weight_kg' with both starting_value and target_value set, the app computes a live progress bar from logged vitals.

target_metric.description: e.g. 'weight_kg' — only 'weight_kg' drives a progress bar today

tools.name: update_wellness_goal_status
tools.title: Update Wellness Goal Status
tools.description: Mark a Wellness goal achieved or abandoned. Use list_wellness_goals first to find the id.

tools.name: delete_wellness_goal
tools.title: Delete Wellness Goal
tools.description: Delete a Wellness goal. Soft delete. Use list_wellness_goals first to find the id.

tools.name: get_trading_overview
tools.title: Get Trading Overview
tools.description: Trading overview: paper balance, risk %, learning mode, mentor review, course video, current lesson, closed non-legacy paper trades toward the 30 needed, and open trades. Read-only.

tools.name: get_trading_stats
tools.title: Get Trading Stats
tools.description: Paper trading stats (same as the app's stats card): closed count, win rate, total R, avg R, avg win/loss in R, % rules followed, largest losing streak. Read-only.

tools.name: list_paper_trades
tools.title: List Paper Trades
tools.description: List paper trades. Read-only.

tools.name: get_trading_plan
tools.title: Get Trading Plan
tools.description: Get the written Trading Plan (8 sections) and when it was last updated. Read-only.

tools.name: list_course_progress
tools.title: List Course Progress
tools.description: List the 12 trading course lessons with status, notes and whether each is locked. Read-only.

tools.name: list_watchlist
tools.title: List Watchlist
tools.description: List watchlists and their items, including TradingView symbols. Read-only.

tools.name: list_key_levels
tools.title: List Key Levels
tools.description: List support/resistance key levels for a symbol or watchlist item, with the verified flag. Read-only.

tools.name: get_market_pulse
tools.title: Get Market Pulse
tools.description: Cached market prices with as-of time and real 1-day change (null when unknown — never invented), plus the risk mood computed the same way as the app. Prices update about once a day. Read-only.

tools.name: log_paper_trade
tools.title: Log Paper Trade
tools.description: Log a new PAPER trade (no real money). Risk % comes from the user's settings and cannot be set here; risk amount and position size are calculated by the database exactly as in the app.

calendar_checked.description: Must be true — the economic calendar was checked

tools.name: move_stop_loss
tools.title: Move Stop Loss
tools.description: Move the stop loss on an open paper trade. Moving it further from entry is refused.

tools.name: close_paper_trade
tools.title: Close Paper Trade
tools.description: Close an open paper trade. R-multiple, P/L and the paper balance are calculated by the database exactly as in the app.

tools.name: update_trading_plan
tools.title: Update Trading Plan
tools.description: Update named Trading Plan sections only; sections not passed stay unchanged. The previous version is kept in history.

tools.name: update_lesson_progress
tools.title: Update Lesson Progress
tools.description: Set a course lesson's status and notes. Lesson N can only be started or completed after lesson N-1 is completed.

tools.name: add_key_level
tools.title: Add Key Level
tools.description: Add a support/resistance zone to a watchlist symbol. Always saved as a Claude draft (unverified) — the user verifies it on the chart.

symbol.description: Used when watchlist_item_id is not given

tools.name: add_watchlist_item
tools.title: Add Watchlist Item
tools.description: Add a symbol to an existing watchlist (by id or name).

asset_type.description: e.g. fx, crypto, commodity, index, stock. Defaults to fx
